record.title: Coupled resonators: loading, voltage gain and the complete source budget
record.question: Can passive magnetically coupled resonators produce receiver voltage above source voltage while all receiver power remains accounted for by the source and losses?
record.incoming_evidence: Atlas V4 checked a single RLC circuit but not a coupled receiver or reflected source impedance. Tesla's coupled tuning is a source-grounded mechanism; it does not imply source-free energy.

historical_lenses.Tesla: Specify coupled coils, phase, receiver loading and return paths.
historical_lenses.Newton: Reconstruct a cause from observed receiver voltage only after testing alternative source/loading explanations.

record.classification: Modern reconstruction and synthetic circuit fixture, not Tesla's numerical apparatus, new law, measured efficiency or proof of energy extraction from vacuum.

state_and_units.R: series resistances including receiver load, ohm

model.phasor: Z(omega) I = (V,0); Z11=R1+i(omega L1-1/(omega C1)); Z22=R2+RL+i(omega L2-1/(omega C2)); Z12=Z21=i omega M. Phasors are peak amplitudes; average power uses 1/2.
model.transient: qdot=i; L idot=(Vpeak sin(omega0 t),0)-diag(R1,R2+RL)i-diag(1/C1,1/C2)q; q(0)=i(0)=0.
model.storage: E=(i^T L i + q^T diag(1/C)q)/2, with |k|<1 ensuring positive definite L.
model.budget: Psource=Re(V conjugate(I1))/2; Pload=RL |I2|^2/2; Ploss=(R1|I1|^2+R2|I2|^2)/2. Finite-time source work = load heat + winding heat + stored-energy change.
model.boundary: Ideal sinusoidal source, lumped linear elements, no core hysteresis, stray capacitance, radiation, temperature dependence, source impedance beyond R1, sensor loading or environmental drive.

observables: Receiver power/source real power for nonzero source power
Reflected impedance and complete transient work balance
rival_explanations: Voltage gain is an impedance/phase effect supplied by source power
Apparent excess could arise by comparing peak voltage to real power or omitting source backaction
controls: Zero coupling gives zero receiver response
Zero source gives zero phasor response
Reverse M: receiver phase flips by pi; powers unchanged
At common uncoupled resonance, compare complex currents against closed-form reflected-resistance expression
Double both winding resistances and inspect efficiency reduction at fixed omega0 and nominal RL
Two transient sample spacings and tighter solver tolerance; perform external Simpson work quadrature, not only integrated work states

acceptance.gain_witness: Report at least one fixed parameter row with voltage gain >1 AND efficiency <=1; if absent report failure rather than tune beyond frozen domain.

record.falsifier: Any reproducible passive-model budget violation beyond declared tolerance rejects this implementation; voltage gain alone cannot support a free-energy claim.
limits: Finite fixture and frequency/load grid are not a global optimization theorem
No apparatus has been built or measured
The lumped circuit has no gravity or cosmological degree of freedom
record.next_round_rule: Independent review selects the next question. Candidate only: whether phase-resolved two-channel readout can localize a drive once this forward model is checked. Do not execute before the R1B review.

record.title: Which drive is visible? Phase readout and source localization
record.question: Under the R1 circuit, which source-channel combinations are identifiable from amplitude-only, single complex-channel and two coherent complex-channel observations, and how can readout error create a false receiver-drive residual?

incoming_evidence.accepted: Passive coupled loading closes the energy budget; receiver voltage gain alone does not locate the drive.

record.classification: Modern synthetic inverse-problem fixture. Inferred effective voltage is not identification of dark matter, free energy, gravity or a historical Tesla theory.

state_and_units.e1,e2: unknown complex effective peak source voltages, V; domain C² = R⁴
state_and_units.reconstruction_disk: deterministic complex voltage-error disk, V; not a confidence interval

parameters.inherits: R1 nominal inductances, capacitances, R1,R2,RL20ohm, omega0

model.forward: I=Z^-1 e with the checked R1 nominal Z; both actual source port voltages are unknown for inference. Source knob values are not substituted for measured source voltages.
model.identifiability: Report domain dimension4 and real ranks/nullities. For nonlinear squared-amplitude maps distinguish local Jacobian kernels at the nonzero fixture from exact finite phase-rival families; zero-current boundary has rank0 for those squared maps.
model.exact_rivals: Full receiver complex current is unchanged by I→I+(delta,0), e→e+Z(delta,0). Both current magnitudes are unchanged by I→(I1,exp(i phi)I2), e→Z I'. Verify changed source vectors reproduce identical restricted observations.
model.coherent_reconstruction: ehat=Zhat Ihat; calibrated full complex map rank4. For secondary reconstruction with only M uncertain and |δIj|≤epsilon_j, bound |ehat2-e2| ≤ omega |Mhat| epsilon1 + |Zhat22| epsilon2 + omega ΔM (|Ihat1|+epsilon1). All other component parameters exact in this bounded model.
model.phase_artifact: Set true e2=0. Rotate only measured I2 by each frozen phase error and reconstruct ehat2. Compare exact artifact Z22 I2(exp(i phi)-1) with numerical inversion.
model.boundary: No cosmological field, stochastic detector noise, calibration drift, instrument transfer uncertainty beyond specified disk/M bounds, nonlinear material response or unmeasured additional port.

controls: Nominal two-current complex reconstruction returns injected source voltages
Explicit exact phase-rival and receiver-kernel examples
Analytical real Jacobians with ranks and kernel witnesses for all four maps; distinguish zero-current squared-amplitude rank0
128 boundary fixtures: 8 phases per independent current error times two M error endpoints; evaluate deterministic disk inclusion, no probabilistic coverage claim
Zero receiver drive with phase error creates a nonzero reconstructed receiver drive
Compare bounded disk exclusion of zero for nominal injected signal; unknown calibration means withhold unconditional signal claim

acceptance.positive_control: Nominal5mV fixture with stated bounds excludes zero; absence must be reported, not repaired by retuning parameters.

artifacts: CSV observations, rivals and uncertainty fixtures
record.falsifier: Failure to recover the stipulated effective drive under exact calibrated full readout rejects the implementation; a restricted observation with an exact rival cannot establish source identity.
limits: Effective source location is not physical source identity
Calibration bounds are supplied assumptions, not measured performance
Rank calculations are finite model properties; real instruments require calibrated transfer functions
No dark-matter search sensitivity or detection significance is calculated
record.next_round_rule: Choose R3 only after R2B. Candidate: add an environmental witness to test whether a residual receiver drive can be separated from ordinary pickup, and identify which witness/calibration assumptions are indispensable.

limits: This is a bounded inventory of explicit record data, source clauses, supplied geometry/material leaves and generated-sketch labels, not a complete parser of arbitrary mathematical prose.
Numeric/alphanumeric text occurrences without a source-grounded role remain gaps even if their containing clause has a description; no claim of 100% scientific normalization is made.
Positive numerical tolerances are computational criteria, not measurement precision, probabilities or device performance.

Overloaded symbols can have multiple definitions. Occurrence-level ambiguity is exposed rather than guessed. Ordinary prose articles are counted separately and are not unknown physical specifications.
External patent figure references and original image-only labels require their own source ledger; generated sketch labels are not a transcription of every original source image.

guide.title: Two coupled loops: reproduce the budget before hardware
guide.goal: Track source loading, receiver response and the complete signed energy account.
prerequisites: Understand peak versusRMS, common phase reference and passive energy storage.
Use an isolated low-voltage source only after actual component/probe limits are documented.

steps.title: Start with the pinned model
instructions: Open the source record and attached contract; write down the observed quantity, units and rival explanation.
Run the existing numerical controls before selecting physical parts; record the exact source commit and original parameter conventions.
checks: A completed software test is not a completed apparatus test.
stopIf: The contract or source identity is missing, or its peak/RMS and unit convention is unresolved.

steps.title: Close the specification gap
instructions: Transcribe the pinned two-loop topology and winding-dot convention into a reviewed connection drawing.
List actual coil, capacitor, load, source and probe part numbers; measure L, M and R before comparing hardware with the numerical contract.
checks: Record turn count, wire, core and ratings as chosen implementation values, not inherited facts.
stopIf: Any rating, ground path, isolation requirement or actual inductance is unknown.

steps.title: Commission ordinary controls before a claimed gain
instructions: With the source at zero, record background and instrument offsets.
Use a known dummy load and minimum documented source setting; acquire all channels on the same reference.
Change receiving load and coupling one variable at a time; retain raw traces and endpoints for storage.
checks: Source-off yields the declared null within measured uncertainty.
Uncoupled receiver and sign-reversedM controls match the implemented model.
stopIf: Clipping, heating, drift,ground coupling or missing source/storage work prevents a closed account.

parts.quantity: One source; enough coherent channels for all observables
parts.measurableQuantity: Source voltage, primary current, receiver current and load voltage; bandwidth and phase error
parts.specification: Source voltage, primary current, receiver current and load voltage; bandwidth and phase error
selectionCriteria: Select differential or isolated channels with a common timebase.
Characterize source impedance, channel phase and the burden added by every probe. A two-input audio interface alone is not the required four-observable electrical readout.

parts.measurableQuantity: Self-inductance L1/L2, mutual inductance M, resistance and geometry
parts.specification: Self-inductance L1/L2, mutual inductance M, resistance and geometry
selectionCriteria: Frozen R1 declares 10 mH and 40 mH, with M = 3 mH. Geometry does not supply a winding turn count.
Measure signed mutual inductance and both self-inductances at every gap; choose wire, core, insulation and thermal ratings separately.

parts.measurableQuantity: C1/C2, AC voltage, ripple current and tolerance
parts.specification: C1/C2, AC voltage, ripple current and tolerance
selectionCriteria: The R1 values 10 µF and 2.5 µF are numerical targets, not verified MKP10 stock codes.
Inspect the chosen part’s AC, ripple, tolerance and temperature specifications.

representativeProducts.name: MKP10 film-capacitor family
representativeProducts.fit: role reference, not a validated drop-in or commissioned system

parts.quantity: Two current-sense roles and one useful load
parts.measurableQuantity: Resistance, power rating and temperature coefficient
parts.specification: Resistance, power rating and temperature coefficient
selectionCriteria: Choose shunts so their burden is included in the circuit model.
Recalculate dissipation and bandwidth. A WSL current-sense part is not a recommendation for the 20 Ω useful load.

representativeProducts.name: WSL current-sense resistor family
representativeProducts.fit: role reference, not a validated drop-in or commissioned system

buildabilityGate.decision: desk study ready; apparatus conditional—not released for construction
requiredEvidence: Chosen complete part numbers and current manufacturer documentation
Documented ratings, tolerances, connections and measurement uncertainty for the actual implementation
Independent topology/measurement review and successful commissioning controls
missing: Coil turns, core, wire, actual L/M, component ratings, source impedance and calibrated four-observable readout remain unspecified.

commissioningControls: Source off; uncoupled coils; known load; reversed winding sign; repeated gap settings.
Independent signed-work quadrature and endpoint storage; peak/RMS check.
successCriteria: The passive forward model predicts held-out load changes within a predeclared uncertainty.
Measure every energy term or identify it explicitly as modeled; report residuals with uncertainty.
falsifier: A repeatable budget failure beyond uncertainty rejects the present implementation or measurement account.
Voltage gain alone cannot establish unexplained energy or identify its source.

sources.title: WIMA MKP10 polypropylene pulse capacitors
sources.readingDepth: Product-page construction, capacitance/voltage range and electrical-data overview read
sources.finding: Manufacturer describes polypropylene pulse capacitors and model-dependent capacitance, voltage and lead-spacing ranges.
sources.limit: Family range does not verify availability, tolerance or AC/ripple rating of a chosen10µF/2.5µF part. No purchasing recommendation or complete BOM approval.

sources.title: Vishay WSL Power Metal Strip resistors · document30100
sources.readingDepth: PDF p1 standard electrical specifications and rating/derating note read; full device design not evaluated
sources.finding: Model-specific low-value resistance, tolerance and power ratings are tabulated; WSL2512 values above0.1Ω have a derating note.
sources.limit: A current-sense shunt is not a direct replacement for the frozen2Ω/3Ω winding resistance or20Ω load. Final value/package/thermal design must be selected and measured.

sources.title: The search for low-mass axion dark matter with ABRACADABRA-10cm ·2021
sources.readingDepth: Actual arXiv fullHTML: abstract, selected magnet-off-veto discussion and SupplementaryIII Detector calibration read; entire paper not read
sources.finding: End-to-end calibration, known injection and magnet-off/background checks address the complete transfer; the paper reports no significant evidence for axions.
sources.limit: This bench borrows calibration logic, not cryogenic apparatus specifications, sensitivity, axion coupling or discovery significance. Their peak-to-peak/RMS conversion is specific to their readout.

sources.title: Tesla US1119732A · Apparatus for transmitting electrical energy
sources.readingDepth: GooglePatents metadata and selected apparatus-description paragraphs on coupled/tuned circuits read; legal claims not fully analyzed
sources.finding: The patent describes primary/secondary inductive relationships and resonant adjustment.
sources.limit: A patent records an asserted design, not tested efficiency, overunity, safety or a construction release. No high-voltage patent apparatus is proposed for this bench.

sources.title: Maximizing wireless power transfer efficiency at exceptional points (2025)
sources.readingDepth: Selected retained full text read independently: abstract, gain/loss Results and inverter/controller description, Conclusions.
sources.finding: The authors propose adaptive virtual-load loss adjustment in an active parity-time-symmetric WPT system; source gain and receiver losses are explicit.
sources.limit: This active converter system is not the existing passive R1/R2 fixture. No efficiency, component value or hardware performance is transferred to this workbench.

sourceRecords.readingDepth: Local source file read directly by registry generator; upstream primary publications retain their separate source-ledger reading depth.

guide.sourceBoundary: Frozen source values are numerical fixtures or proposed geometry, not inferred product ratings. Representative products illustrate roles; no purchase, price, availability or fitted performance was verified.
proposedImprovements: First retain the unchanged passive source fixture and measure a held-out load/coupling sweep with calibrated phase-aware readout.

Only as a separate future design branch, compare adaptive receiver loading. Count every converter, controller and auxiliary supply in source work; do not transfer the 2025 active PT system’s efficiency or numerical parameters.

sources.title: USPTO MPEP §608.02 — Drawing
sources.readingDepth: Selected drawing/completeness/correction passages read from the official §608 page; not all 874 kB.
sources.finding: Necessary drawings and consistent disclosure matter; later drawings cannot cure original insufficient disclosure or add original claim scope.
sources.limit: MPEP guidance is distinct from the current regulation; displayed subsection revision is January 2024.

sources.title: 37 CFR §1.84 — Standards for drawings
sources.readingDepth: Current eCFR title displayed as of 13 November 2026. Selected drawing standards read.
sources.finding: A4 or US Letter, specified margins, black-line default, ≥3.2 mm characters, consistent references and US figure/sheet rules.
sources.limit: Current regulation text retrieved; not an audit of every filing channel, exception or application type.

sources.title: EPC Rule46 — deleted historical form-of-drawings provision
sources.readingDepth: Current official page and deletion/version-history note read; historical text distinguished from current law.
sources.finding: Deleted effective 1 February 2023 by CA/D10/22; do not cite former Rule46 as the current drawing authority.
sources.limit: Historical text remains displayed on the official page and can mislead a title-only reading.

sources.title: EPC Rule42 — content of description
sources.readingDepth: Full short operative description provision read.
sources.finding: Technical field, background art, problem/solution, figures, at least one detailed way of carrying out, industrial applicability where not obvious.
sources.limit: A description template cannot supply absent enabling parameters or establish a claimed technical effect.

sources.title: EPC Rule43 — form and content of claims
sources.readingDepth: Selected technical-feature, dependent-claim, numbering and reference-sign provisions read.
sources.finding: Claims define technical features; number claims; avoid reliance on figures alone; parenthesised reference signs may aid intelligibility without limiting the claim.
sources.limit: No legal claim drafting or novelty/inventive-step conclusion for the repositories is provided.

sources.title: EPC Article83 — disclosure of invention
sources.readingDepth: Full short operative disclosure provision read.
sources.finding: Disclose sufficiently clearly and completely for a person skilled in the art to carry out the invention.
sources.limit: A neat drawing does not satisfy sufficiency when necessary operating information is missing.

sources.title: EPO Guidelines2026 F-II4.1 — general description remarks
sources.readingDepth: Selected purpose-of-description paragraphs read.
sources.finding: Description enables practice and understanding of the contribution to the art.
sources.limit: Guidance on examination, not a substitute for the EPC or case-specific legal assessment.

sources.title: PCT Rule11 — physical requirements of international application
sources.readingDepth: Selected sheet/margin/numbering/text/drawing provisions read.
sources.finding: A4, drawing margins, minimal words, black-line drawings, ≥3.2mm drawing characters and consistent reference signs.
sources.limit: PCT international-phase rules differ from EPO regional electronic practice; request-text2.1mm and ordinary-text2.8mm are not drawing-glyph minima.

sources.title: EPC Rule49(2) — presentation requirements delegated to EPO President
sources.readingDepth: Selected current paragraph and references read; tracked/deleted prior paragraphs not treated as current authority.
sources.finding: The President determines presentation requirements; page links OJ2025A49 and A57.
sources.limit: Current and struck/deleted historical wording coexist in the page; use the current President decision for mechanical details.

sources.title: EPO President decision25November2022 — OJ2022A113
sources.section: Arts1,2 and entry-into-force; supersession checked against2025A49 Art6
sources.readingDepth: Selected drawing/presentation provisions and successor supersession text read.
sources.finding: Former delegated presentation requirements, superseded on 1 October 2025 by OJ2025A49.
sources.limit: Not the current EPO drawing authority.

sources.title: EPO Guidelines2026 A-IX3 — paper-drawing conditions
sources.section: A-IX3 paper conditions and current decision reference
sources.readingDepth: Selected paper/reproduction paragraphs and A49 cross-reference read.
sources.finding: Paper conditions remain relevant to paper filings; the page updates its decision reference to2025A49.
sources.limit: Not used as an electronic-colour prohibition; current A49 controls that distinction.

sources.title: EPO Guidelines2026 F-III1 — sufficiency
sources.section: F-III1 selected first,third and structure/function paragraphs
sources.readingDepth: Selected essential-feature, whole-area-claimed and structure/function discussion read.
sources.finding: Essential features need sufficient detail; broad claims need enabling coverage without undue burden; structure and function must be explained.
sources.limit: A beginner tutorial is an educational extension; the legal addressee is the person skilled in the art.

sources.title: EPC Article84 — claims
sources.readingDepth: Full short operative claims provision read.
sources.finding: Claims define protection sought and must be clear, concise and supported by the description.
sources.limit: Model correlations and unexplained performance assertions do not create claim support.

sources.title: USPTO MPEP §2164 — Enablement requirement
sources.section: §2164 opening discussion: make/use and undue experimentation
sources.readingDepth: Selected opening enablement discussion and undue-experimentation passages read.
sources.finding: Claims define the invention to enable; sufficient making/using information is required without undue experimentation.
sources.limit: No conclusion that a hypothetical setup satisfies 35 USC112(a); later case law beyond passages read was not exhaustively audited.

sources.title: EPO President decision7July2025 — OJ2025A49
sources.readingDepth: Operative drawing/presentation articles, supersession and effective-date provisions read.
sources.finding: Effective1October2025: A4, margins, ≥3.2mm drawing characters, minimal text; electronic colour/greyscale permitted subject to contrast and300dpi suitability.
sources.limit: Technical profile alignment is not certification, acceptance, sufficiency or a claim of EU-wide harmonised patent law.

sources.title: EPO notice5September2025 — colour/greyscale drawings, OJ2025A57
sources.readingDepth: Selected Euro-direct, PCT and Euro-PCT transition paragraphs read.
sources.finding: EPO electronic colour is permitted under A49; PCT international-phase colour remains inadmissible; Euro-PCT transition depends on dates and PATENTSCOPE availability.
sources.limit: Do not generalise EPO electronic colour permission to every office, paper filing or PCT international publication.

sources.title: EPC Article123 — amendments
sources.readingDepth: Selected no-added-subject-matter and post-grant scope provisions read.
sources.finding: An amended European application/patent may not extend beyond the content as filed; post-grant protection may not be extended.
sources.limit: An educational later drawing is not a reconstruction of what an earlier patent application disclosed.

sources.title: 37 CFR §1.71 — Detailed description and specification
sources.readingDepth: Current eCFR title as of 13 November 2026; selected description paragraphs read.
sources.finding: Describe making and using in full, clear, concise and exact terms sufficient for a person skilled in the art.
sources.limit: Not an assessment that any repository proposal is enabled or patentable.

requirements.label: Drawing sheet size
requirements.rule: US §1.84(f): A4 210×297mm or US Letter216×279mm; EPO A49Art2(2)/PCT11.5 use A4 (PCT receiving-office exception does not alter A4 record-copy rule).

requirements.label: Drawing margins and sight
requirements.rule: US1.84(g), A49Art1(1), PCT11.6(c): minimum top25,left25,right15,bottom10mm; A4 sight no greater than170×262mm; no frame around usable area.

requirements.label: Reference-number and letter height
requirements.rule: US1.84(p)(3), A49Art1(2)(g), PCT11.13(h): drawing numbers/letters at least3.2mm high. Do not substitute EPO2.1mm description text minimum.

requirements.label: Two-thirds reproduction readability
requirements.rule: US1.84(k), A49Art1(2)(c), PCT11.13(c): details remain distinguishable after linear reduction to two-thirds; requires actual legibility review, not only a numeric SVG test.

requirements.label: Monochrome common profile
requirements.rule: US1.84(a),(l) and PCT11.13(a) support black-line default. A49Art1(2)(a) allows electronically filed colour/greyscale with contrast/300dpi suitability; monochrome here is a conservative profile choice.

requirements.label: Keep lengthy explanation off drawing sheet
requirements.rule: A49Art1(2)(j), PCT11.11 permit only indispensable short words; keep full definitions, products and teaching prose in separate description/reference documents.

requirements.label: Stable reference signs and cross-reference legend
requirements.rule: US1.84(p)(4)–(5), A49Art1(2)(i), PCT11.13(l)–(n): same feature uses same sign; drawing/description references correspond; separate feature list is useful.

requirements.label: Unambiguous leader lines
requirements.rule: US1.84(q): short lines from near character to feature, noncrossing; surface/section exception uses underline. Reference signs must not obscure drawing lines/hatching.

requirements.label: Sufficient distinct views
requirements.rule: US1.84(h)–(j), A49Art1(2)(h), PCT11.13(i)–(k): necessary views separated, not overlapping; partial views assemble without obscuring detail.

requirements.label: Figure and sheet numbers are separate
requirements.rule: US1.84(u): sequential FIG.1 etc, larger than reference signs; a single-view US application must have neither view number nor FIG. EPO/PCT sequential Arabic figure numbering is independent of sheets.

requirements.label: Sheet numbering placement
requirements.rule: US1.84(t): if present, sheet/total format and larger than reference characters within sight; EPOA49Art2(5) top-centred not in margin; PCT11.7 top/bottom-centred not margin.

requirements.label: US scan targets are recommended, not mandatory
requirements.rule: US1.84(g) says sheets should have scan target crosshairs on two catercorner margin corners. This is not a four-marker must requirement and not an EPO/PCT common mandate.

requirements.label: Cross-section hatching
requirements.rule: US1.84(h)(3), A49Art1(2)(b), PCT11.13(b): hatching should remain distinguishable and not impede reference signs/leaders. No section/material is inferred where source geometry is absent.

requirements.label: Proportions and scale indications
requirements.rule: US1.84(k) prohibits actual-size/scale1/2 indications. EPO/PCT exceptional scale indications use a graphic scale; preserve proportions unless a clarity exception is explicit.

requirements.label: Separate description structure
requirements.rule: EPC Rule42(1)(a)–(f): field, useful known background, problem/solution and advantageous effects, brief figures, at least one detailed way of carrying out, industrial applicability when not obvious. US1.71(a)–(c) asks full/clear making-and-using description.

requirements.label: Define symbols and reference features without changing conventions
requirements.rule: Explain source-dependent units, peak/RMS conventions and feature functions in the description/reference table; distinguish this educational completeness policy from a claim that every symbol is legally prescribed.

requirements.label: Claim language and support
requirements.rule: EPC Art84 and Rule43: clear concise supported technical features, proper dependency/numbering; claims cannot merely say as shown in a figure; reference signs in claims are parenthesised where useful.

requirements.label: Enablement is separate from drawing mechanics
requirements.rule: US1.71/MPEP2164 and EPCArt83/F-III1 require sufficient making/using information for a skilled person without undue experimentation/burden. Unknown essential turns/ratings/calibration or unproven effects remain gaps, not invented values.

requirements.label: Later drawings cannot silently add original disclosure
requirements.rule: MPEP608.02 quotes35USC113/37CFR1.81(d): later drawings cannot cure missing enabling disclosure or supplement original claim scope. EPCArt123(2) forbids extension beyond content as filed; label new educational geometry as new authored material.

requirements.label: Proposed examples and operated setups remain separate
requirements.rule: For this product, record whether an example is a source assertion, hypothetical procedure, deterministic model or measured apparatus. No mechanical-sheet check establishes physical validation or claim sufficiency.

requirements.label: Scratch setup document is an educational extension
requirements.rule: A reader setup guide should list known components, tools, units, prerequisites, interfaces, measurement/calibration plan, controls and missing specifications; standards address the skilled person, not a guarantee of novice buildability.

sources.section: Abstract, Results: exceptional point and maximum efficiency; Conclusions; selected coupled-mode model paragraphs

sources.limit: This active converter system is not the existing passive R1/R2 fixture. No efficiency, component value or hardware performance is transferred to this workbench.

sources.finding: DECOR predicts a late reverberation tail from an early room impulse response; the authors report degraded performance on an unseen dataset.
sources.limit: A predicted tail is synthetic. It cannot recover a unique monument geometry, material response or historical sound without independent measurements.

sources.limit: Published application text is a proposal, not independent validation. Its controller/converter cannot be substituted into the fixed passive source model or treated as permission to manufacture.

sources.kind: published patent application; legal status not assessed

sources.finding: The application describes phased acoustic transducer elements and a reflector-relative standing-wave arrangement.
sources.limit: This is a separate ultrasonic hardware proposal, not an effect produced by phone audio, a monument image or the current audible sonification. No operating power, exposure limit or compatible hardware is established here.

improvements.title: Compare coupling and load robustness before adaptive control
improvements.proposal: Record a calibrated baseline across coil placement and receiving load. Evaluate an adaptive-load candidate as a separate design branch with its converter and controller power inside the energy boundary.
improvements.rationale: The 2025 primary paper makes source gain and receiver loss explicit; its active PT model motivates a controlled comparison rather than silently modifying the passive source fixture.
requiredValidation: Keep source R1/R2 peak-voltage values unchanged in the baseline.
Characterize actual self/mutual inductance and phase-aware sensing at each geometry.
Include every controller/drive/auxiliary supply, load heat, winding loss and endpoint storage in the energy account.
Predefine comparable operating points, uncertainties and pass/fail criteria before a new hardware branch.
improvements.status: proposed research improvement; not implemented or physically validated

improvements.title: Evaluate synthetic late reverberation separately from measured room response
improvements.proposal: Retain the raw measured response and deterministic early-reflection baseline. In a separate optional research branch, compare a predicted late tail with held-out measured rooms and clearly label all inferred samples.
improvements.rationale: The 2025 DECOR full-text discussion identifies unseen-room generalization losses. A modelled tail is useful for auralization while retaining the measurement and inference boundary.
requiredValidation: Review code/data licenses before any model import; no model is downloaded or added here.
Keep held-out rooms separate from training or tuning.
Record sampling rate, excitation, microphone calibration, source and receiver positions and processing.
Compare frequency-dependent decay and waveform/energy diagnostics against actual measured tails; report uncertainty and failure cases.
Do not label the predicted tail as a measured monument resonance or intrinsic material damping.
improvements.status: proposed research improvement; not implemented or physically validated

improvements.title: Log frequency, supply and tuning state as separate control variables
improvements.proposal: Define a separate controlled-excitation test branch whose experimental log records drive frequency, supply voltage, selected capacitor configuration and source power at each step.
improvements.rationale: A recent 2026 application distinguishes these control variables. Keeping them separately recorded prevents an apparent improvement caused by an unnoticed input-power change.
requiredValidation: Preserve the frozen source baseline and proposed branch as different revisions.
Document all switched capacitance ratings, transient limits and controller/converter auxiliary power before assembly.
Run fixed-load and fixed-source controls with calibrated simultaneous voltage/current acquisition.
Compare total energy and uncertainty, not receiver voltage alone.
improvements.status: proposed research improvement; not implemented or physically validated

improvements.title: Separate input, branch and load energy measurement boundaries
improvements.proposal: Create a commissioning worksheet with independently identified input, transfer-branch and receiving-load energy channels, signed polarity and start/end storage states.
improvements.rationale: The 2026 application explicitly distinguishes input and distributed energy accounting. The transferable research question is boundary completeness; its road-metering implementation is not adopted.
requiredValidation: Calibrate each voltage/current channel including phase and clock alignment.
Include internal loss, external supports/auxiliary sources and endpoint stored energy.
Compare an independent energy quadrature with the original solver accounting.
Do not equate current allocation with measured load energy without the corresponding voltage and phase.
improvements.status: proposed research improvement; not implemented or physically validated

improvements.title: Test load-state transition timing and feedback delay
improvements.proposal: Preregister a test for whether load changes, acquisition timing or delayed feedback can create apparent power-gain peaks; keep fixed-state baselines and state-transition receipts.
improvements.rationale: The 2026 application identifies load states, coupling references and synchronization. They motivate controls for transient artifacts before any adaptive control is added.
requiredValidation: Log the exact source, load and feedback state against a shared clock.
Compare delayed and exchanged-channel controls.
Measure rather than infer coupling from gap or a product name.
Record every drive/controller supply and validate stability before a hardware fork.
improvements.status: proposed research improvement; not implemented or physically validated

improvements.title: Keep ultrasonic trapping as a separately specified experimental branch
improvements.proposal: If acoustic manipulation is investigated, create a separate transducer/controller/reflector specification and position-calibration protocol rather than interpreting a phone or image-mapped pitch as a trapping field.
improvements.rationale: The 2024 application is an explicit controlled phase-and-reflector proposal. It identifies why the current audible mixed-recording setup cannot itself establish levitation.
requiredValidation: Obtain an actual transducer, drive, geometry and exposure specification before a hardware procedure.
Define calibrated position/force observations and ordinary mechanical/acoustic alternatives.
Retain source-only, reflector-position and object-removed controls.
No ultrasonic drive instructions, exposure limits or claimed trapping performance are supplied by this documentation.
improvements.status: proposed research improvement; not implemented or physically validated
